newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Thieves get $1.3 million in Brussels art robbery.
newsitem.headline: Thieves get $1.3 million in Brussels art robbery.

text.p: Thieves using duplicate keys broke into the Royal Museum of Art and History in Brussels and got away with silver and ivory objects worth an estimated 43 million francs ($1.3 million), police said on Friday.
The theft of the 10 German silver objects dating from 17th century and an ivory sculpture was discovered on Wednesday morning.
A police spokesman said film from surveillance cameras was being studied for evidence.
He added that it would not be easy for the thieves to sell the stolen objects because of their unique character.
A spokesman for the museum, in Brussels' Cinquentenaire park, said he had been ordered by the museum's director to make absolutely no comment to the media.
